decisions.decision: Turn the tunnel off. Steps: (1) Run `launchctl bootout gui/$UID/com.tantra.preview-tunnel`. Also remove `com.tantra.preview-tunnel` from ~/Library/LaunchAgents (move the plist to ~/.pr-preview/disabled/) so it does not restart at login. (2) Leave com.tantra.preview-refresh and com.tantra.preview-gateway running on 127.0.0.1 only, so branch previews still work on this Mac. (3) Run workshop-plan/ops/revops_sheet.py so the RevOps Workshop Series tab (gid 1133663049) points at live links on https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/ and contains no trycloudflare URLs. Check that a few links load while logged out. (4) Update memory team-review-tunnels: 'T-194 decided 2026-10-09: tunnel OFF. Teammates review merged work on GitHub Pages and unmerged work through the PR diff.' (5) Log the decision in T-194, check that `launchctl list | grep preview-tunnel` returns nothing, and mark the task done.
decisions.why: The tunnel is a public way into Adi's Mac, running with no recorded approval. Memory team-review-tunnels records that the safety classifier blocked it. The tunnel's URL changes every time it restarts, so the sheet's links break anyway. Merged work already has permanent GitHub Pages mirrors (T-036, T-098).
